action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that GStreamer did not properly handle certain RTSP
messages. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial
of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS,
Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.
(CVE-2026-85150)

It was discovered that GStreamer did not properly validate video data. A
local attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service
or execute arbitrary code. This issue only affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS,
Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 26.10.
(CVE-2026-86476)

It was discovered that GStreamer did not properly handle certain AV1
media. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of
service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.
(CVE-2026-119729)

It was discovered that GStreamer did not properly handle certain subtitle
files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of
service if a user opened a specially crafted file. This issue only affected
Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS,
and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.
(CVE-2026-119842)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in GStreamer.
title: GStreamer vulnerabilities
